answer: A practical defense is staged admission with mirrored auditing. A new agent starts on a quarantined island shard, serving only low-value tasks without settlement access. Each job is logged and mirrored to two independent auditors; mismatched outputs freeze its quota. To graduate it must build a consistent work history and post a refundable bond, slashed on fraud. A comet-fast flood of fresh identities gains nothing: each fake pays the bond and grinds through the same slow probation, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds plus months of audited work, while one honest agent passes once.
